MySupport.title: Support requests
MySupport.signedOutBody: Sign in to see your support requests.
MySupport.intro: To open a new request, use “Request support” on an event, order or ticket page. Replies refresh automatically.
MySupport.emptyBody: Need help with a booking? Open it from <link>My Tickets</link> and choose “Request support”.

RequestSupport.invalid: Add a short subject and describe the issue.
RequestSupport.reportNote: Reports go to BiletFlow platform administrators, not the organizer.
RequestSupport.organizerNote: Your request goes to the event organizer's support team. You'll see their replies under Support.
RequestSupport.categoryLabel: What do you need help with?
RequestSupport.subject: Subject
